R e s p o n d e n t s ___________________________________________________________ For Petitioners : Mr. Sourabh Sharma, Advocate.

For Respondents/NTPC : Mr. Anuroop Panda,
Advocate For Respondents/State : Mr. Soumitra Kesharwani, P.L. Hon'ble Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board 06/08/2024Sd/- Sd/-
1.

At the outset, learned counsel for respondents raised an objection with regard to maintainability of writ petition and submits that petitioners are having alternate efficacious remedy under Section 64 or Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.

2. In view of the objection raised by learned counsel for respondents, after arguing for sometime,
learned counsel for petitioners submits that he may be permitted to withdraw this petition with liberty to avail the alternate remedy available to them under the law.
3. In view of the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for parties, writ petitions are dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty as prayed for.

Sd/-
